name: ZCA_WEB_ACTIVITIES
description: This table ZCA_WEB_ACTIVITIES stores all valid web activities imported from Eloqua.

columns.name: WEB_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of a web activity record.

columns.name: WEB_ACTIVITY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for a web activity record.

columns.name: ELQ_EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the activity across activity types. Primary Key of the table from Eloqua.

columns.name: ELQ_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the activity per activity type, except for EmailSend.

columns.name: ELQ_ACTIVITY_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the Eloqua type of activity

columns.name: ELQ_ACTIVITY_DATE
columns.description: The date and time of the activity

columns.name: ELQ_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: The email address of the contact who performed the activity.

columns.name: ELQ_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the contact who performed the activity.

columns.name: ELQ_EMAIL_RECIPIENT_ID
columns.description: The recipient GUID associated with an email activity.

columns.name: ELQ_ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: The type of asset associated with the activity, such as email and form.

columns.name: ELQ_ASSET_NAME
columns.description: The name of the asset associated with the activity.

columns.name: ELQ_ASSET_ID
columns.description: The ID of the asset associated with the activity.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: The ID of the email deployment for an email activity OR the ID of the WebVisit associated with a PageView activity OR the ACTIVITY_ID of a Form Submit activity.

columns.name: ELQ_SUBJECT_LINE
columns.description: The subject line for an email activity.

columns.name: ELQ_EMAIL_WEB_LINK
columns.description: The link for viewing the email in a web browser window for an email activity.

columns.name: ELQ_EMAIL_CLICKED_THRU_LINK
columns.description: The link clicked through for an EmailClickThrough activity.

columns.name: ELQ_CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: The ID of the campaign associated with the activity.

columns.name: ELQ_DEPLOYMENT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the email deployment for an email activity.

columns.name: ELQ_EMAIL_SEND_TYPE
columns.description: The type of email send for an email activity. Email send types are BatchWizard, QuickSend, SOAPAPI, Salestools, FormProcessingStep, DCOServicesStep, ExternalTest, TestCenter, Deliverability, LowVolumesAPI and Campaign.

columns.name: ELQ_NUMBER_OF_PAGES
columns.description: The number of pages viewed with a WebVisit activity.

columns.name: ELQ_FIRST_PAGE_VIEW_URL
columns.description: The URL of the first page viewed in a WebVisit activity.

columns.name: ELQ_DURATION
columns.description: The duration of a WebVisit activity returned using the ISO-8601 standard for specifying durations.

columns.name: ELQ_WEB_VISIT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the WebVisit associated with a PageView activity.

columns.name: ELQ_URL
columns.description: The URL viewed with a PageView activity.

columns.name: ELQ_URL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of web visit or page visit URL, retrieved from pattern match, which will be displayed on UI.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the CRM Contact associated with the activity.

columns.name: LEAD_ID
columns.description: The ID of the CRM Lead associated with the activity.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: The ID of the CRM Campaign associated with the activity.

columns.name: OPPORTUNITY_ID
columns.description: The ID of the CRM Opportunity associated with the activity.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_PAGES_SENT
columns.description: The number of pages sent to the user.

columns.name: PAGES_DOWNLOADED
columns.description: The number of pages downloaded by the user.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: The source of the web activity.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
